title: OpenSSH regreSSHion: signal handler race in sshd
summary: Race condition in sshd's SIGALRM handler can allow unauthenticated remote code execution on glibc-based Linux. Exploitation is difficult and timing dependent.
remediation: Upgrade to OpenSSH 9.8p1 or later, or install your distribution's patched package. As a stopgap, LoginGraceTime 0 removes the race but exposes sshd to connection-exhaustion DoS.

title: OpenSSH ssh-agent PKCS#11 remote code execution
summary: Insufficiently trustworthy search path in ssh-agent's PKCS#11 support. Exploitable only when agent forwarding is used toward an attacker-influenced host.
remediation: Upgrade to OpenSSH 9.3p2 or later. Avoid agent forwarding to untrusted hosts.

title: OpenSSH username enumeration
summary: sshd leaks whether a username exists via differing responses to malformed authentication packets.

title: vsftpd 2.3.4 backdoor
summary: A tampered vsftpd 2.3.4 source tarball (June-July 2011) contained a backdoor that opens a root shell on TCP/6200 when a username ending in ':)' is sent.
remediation: Remove the package, reinstall from a trusted source, and treat the host as potentially compromised.

title: Apache httpd 2.4.49 path traversal
summary: Path normalisation flaw allows reading files outside the document root, and code execution if CGI is enabled, unless 'Require all denied' protects those directories.
remediation: Upgrade to Apache httpd 2.4.51 or later.

title: Apache httpd 2.4.49/2.4.50 path traversal and RCE (incomplete fix)
summary: The fix for CVE-2021-41773 was incomplete; encoded traversal sequences still work, enabling file disclosure and RCE when CGI is enabled.
remediation: Upgrade to Apache httpd 2.4.51 or later.

title: nginx resolver off-by-one
summary: Off-by-one in the DNS resolver can be triggered by a forged DNS response when the 'resolver' directive is used.

title: Exim 'Return of the WIZard' remote command execution
summary: Improper recipient validation in deliver_message() allows remote command execution as root.

title: MySQL authentication bypass via memcmp return value
summary: On some builds, repeated login attempts with a wrong password can succeed due to a memcmp() return-value truncation. Only affects certain platform builds.

title: IIS 6.0 WebDAV buffer overflow
summary: Buffer overflow in the WebDAV ScStoragePathFromUrl function allows remote code execution. IIS 6.0 runs only on unsupported Windows Server 2003.
remediation: Migrate off Windows Server 2003 / IIS 6.0; this platform no longer receives security updates.

title: Apache httpd 2.2.x is end-of-life
summary: The 2.2 branch stopped receiving security fixes in 2017; known vulnerabilities remain unpatched.
remediation: Upgrade to a supported Apache httpd 2.4.x release.

title: PHP version is end-of-life (8.0 or older)
summary: PHP 8.0 and older no longer receive security fixes.
remediation: Upgrade to a PHP release that is still within its security-support window.
